earnings.title: November 3, 2026
highlights: Net income attributable to Prudential Financial, Inc. of $1.388 billion or $3.96 per Common share versus net income of $1.431 billion or $4.01 per share for the year-ago quarter.
After-tax adjusted operating income of $1.321 billion or $3.77 per Common share versus $1.444 billion or $4.05 per share for the year-ago quarter.

("Prudential" or the "Company") was $1.388 billion ($3.96 per Common share) for the third quarter of 2026, compared to net income of $1.431 billion ($4.01 per Common share) for the third quarter of 2025.
After-tax adjusted operating income was $1.321 billion ($3.77 per Common share) for the third quarter of 2026, compared to $1.444 billion ($4.05 per Common share) for the third quarter of 2025.

Capital returned to shareholders totaled $741 million, including $250 million of share repurchases and $491 million of dividends, versus $731 million of capital returned to shareholders in the year-ago quarter.

quotes.text: Our third quarter results demonstrate the discipline and consistency with which we are executing across Prudential.
quotes.by: Andy Sullivan, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Prudential Financial

items.heading: Our ability to reprice products is limited and may not compensate for deviations from our expected insurance assumptions.

The profitability of many of our insurance and annuity products, as well as the fees we earn in our investment management business, are subject to market risk. Market risk is the risk of loss from changes in interest rates, equity prices and foreign currency exchange rates.

Guarantees within certain of our products, in particular our variable annuities and to a lesser extent certain individual life and international insurance products, are market sensitive and may decrease our earnings or increase the volatility of our results of operations or financial position.
We are subject to counterparty risk associated with reinsurance transactions.
